It never therefore entered his head to regard it as such, and he saw nothing inconsistent in calling for the abolition of privilege, monopoly, and so forth, while hanging on to his capital.
author: Christopher Caudwell
source: Pacifism and Violence: A Study in Bourgeois Ethics; Quotations; Studies in a Dying Culture (1938)
